## Research

My work centers on analytic methods for counting integral solutions of polynomial equations. I am especially interested in settings where the geometry or weighting of the variables requires refinements of the classical circle method.

::: {.feature-grid}
::: {.feature-card}
### Circle method

Asymptotic formulae, major and minor arc analysis, and systems of Diophantine equations.
:::

::: {.feature-card}
### Exponential sums

Weyl-type estimates, mean values, and applications to additive problems.
:::

::: {.feature-card}
### Arithmetic statistics

Local-to-global principles and the distribution of soluble polynomial equations in families.
:::
:::

## Recent work

::: {.publication-entry}
<span class="publication-status">Preprint</span>

### The Hasse principle for homogeneous polynomials with random coefficients over thin sets II

With Kiseok Yeon. We study the density of coefficient vectors on a thin algebraic set for which the associated homogeneous equation satisfies the Hasse principle.

::: {.paper-links}
